source.author: verg
source.text: Talibus insidiis periurique arte Sinonis credita res, captique dolis lacrimisque coactis, quos neque Tydides, nec Larisaeus Achilles, non anni domuere decem, non mille carinae.
source.text_original: Talibus insidiis periurique arte Sinonis / credita res, captique dolis lacrimisque coactis, / quos neque Tydides, nec Larisaeus Achilles, / non anni domuere decem, non mille carinae.
source.text_english: By such treacheries and by the trickery of perjured Sinon, the matter was believed, and those were taken in by his deceit and forced tears whom neither Tydides nor Larisaean Achilles, not ten years, not a thousand ships, had subdued.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: te quoque Thessalicae, Nestor, rapit in freta puppis fama, Mycenaeis olim qui candida velis aequora et instantes mirabere mille magistros.
reuse.text_original: te quoque Thessalicae, Nestor, rapit in freta puppis / fama, Mycenaeis olim qui candida velis / aequora et instantes mirabere mille magistros.
reuse.text_english: Fame also carries you, Nestor, in the Thessalian sea of the ship, you who once would marvel at the bright waters with Mycenaean sails and a thousand masters pressing close.
